maddeler.e:
تكاسلت (form VI)
# تَكَاسَلْتُ (takāsaltu) /ta.kaː.sal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَاسَلَ (takāsala)
# تَكَاسَلْتَ (takāsalta) /ta.kaː.sal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَاسَلَ (takāsala)
# تَكَاسَلْتِ (takāsalti) /ta.kaː.sal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَاسَلَ (takāsala)
# تَكَاسَلَتْ (takāsalat) /ta.kaː.sa.lat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
